reason: The README clearly describes a session analytics plugin with an in-session visualization tab and self-contained HTML report export, including conservative local redaction and truncation options.

summaries.zh: 在会话内聚合展示令牌、轮次、工具和活动统计，并将会话回放导出为可离线打开的单文件 HTML 报告。
summaries.en: Aggregates token, turn, tool, and activity statistics in a session view and exports session replays as self-contained HTML reports for offline viewing.

capabilities: Analyzes session events into token, turn, tool, and activity statistics
Displays analytics in an in-session tab with periodic refresh
Exports session summaries and replay data as a self-contained HTML file
Redacts selected local paths and truncates tool data by default
Provides loopback GET-only analytics and export routes
